name: desktop-shell
description: DICOM Viewer — desktop shell (Windows, macOS, Linux)
author: DICOM Viewer

scripts.start: npm run build && node scripts/copy-renderer.mjs && electron .
scripts.build:win: npm run build && npm run copy-renderer && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.build:mac: npm run build && npm run copy-renderer && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.build:linux: npm run build && npm run copy-renderer && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
